dedupe_keys.name: pre processed power grid frequency time series for european synchronous areas

description: These data sets give cleaned, ready-to-use grid frequency time series for European synchronous areas, with the scripts that download and clean them. The first release, by Johannes Kruse, Benjamin Schäfer and Dirk Witthaut for their paper Predictability of Power Grid Frequency (IEEE Access, 2020), covers Continental Europe, Great Britain and the Nordic area from 2012 to 2021; an extension by Alexandra Nikoltchovska, Sebastian Pütz, Xiao Li, Veit Hagenmeyer and Benjamin Schäfer (2025) adds 2020 to 2023 for Continental Europe and the Nordic area using the same methods. Recordings come from the German operator TransnetBW and later the SG HoBA data source for Continental Europe, from National Grid ESO for Great Britain, and from Fingrid for the Nordic area. Scripts convert timestamps, mark missing data and identify and clean corrupted recordings, and each yearly file has time stamps and frequency in hertz. Coverage is three European synchronous areas. Files are yearly zipped CSV, about 1 GB for the extension, downloadable from Zenodo at no cost. Caveats: licences differ by source, with TransnetBW retaining copyright and allowing republication on request, and gaps are marked, not filled. Simulation uses are frequency stability, inertia and disturbance analysis and training forecasting models. Related records: model-opinmod-open-inertia-modelling models inertia in dispatch.
licence: Mixed (source TSO terms; CC-BY-4.0 for Fingrid data; MIT for scripts)
